pastis_plan.protocol: One shared permutation per tile/repeat. Remove the nearest integer number of dates from the start of that permutation. Retain at least one date and keep retained dates in chronological order. Both models and all folds share the plan. The 0% case is evaluated once per fold.

pastis_scoring: target-masked macro mIoU over classes 0–18; equal mean of five test folds
external_scoring: audited target masks; macro IoU of true present classes; five-member probability average
